args.query: CPI food at home grocery prices

sql: SELECT a."year", a.period, a.value, b.value AS prior, 100*(a.value/b.value-1) AS yoy FROM econ.food_cpi a JOIN econ.food_cpi b ON a.series=b.series AND a.period=b.period AND b."year"=a."year"-1 WHERE a.series='CUUR0000SAF11' AND a."year">=2025 ORDER BY a."year", a.period
